message: ...After hearing something heavy from Keisetsu.
I can't bring myself to head back to the dorms just yet, so I'm wandering aimlessly around the campus.

name: Iori
message: 「So, Keisetsu will only be at the academy until summer break...」
She said she'd be leaving Japan in August.
It falls right in the middle of summer break, so it might be a convenient time to quit.
The Martial Festival marks the start of summer break. Effectively, the end of this term will be my farewell to Keisetsu.

name: Iori
message: 「...Hm？ Is that Momiji？」
Peering into the training grounds, I see Momiji swinging an Origami all by herself.

name: Iori
message: 「Hey there, Momiji.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Oh, what's wrong, Sensei？」

name: Iori
message: 「I just felt like stopping by, that's all.」
Momiji wraps up her practice and walks over to me.

name: Iori
message: 「Are you doing alright? Anything bothering you?」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, nothing in particular for now.」

name: Momiji
message: 「If I had to say, it's just that I couldn't beat you, Sensei.」
We’ve been sparring regularly since then, but I’ve remained undefeated.

name: Momiji
message: 「You really are strong, Sensei. I guess there’s always someone better out there.」

name: Iori
message: 「What are you talking about? You'll be able to beat me soon enough, Momiji.」

name: Momiji
message: 「You think so？ How much of your hand have you actually shown me so far？」

name: Iori
message: 「I’ve probably shown you about twenty percent.」

name: Momiji
message: 「No way！ That was only twenty percent... Grrr...！」

name: Iori
message: 「Hey, I’ve shown you everything I could. My school of swordsmanship isn't exactly meant to be put on display.」
The rest are just techniques I’ll never use in my life.

name: Momiji
message: 「Damn you, you monster...！」

name: Momiji
message: 「But still, I'm glad our assistant teacher is Iori-sensei.」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha, I'm glad I meet your standards. Back in the beginning, you were quite the handful.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Uwaa, you don't have to bring that up！」
Despite saying that, Momiji looks happy.

name: Momiji
message: 「I couldn't help it, the Suzakuin family is all about independence.」

name: Iori
message: 「I haven’t really been saying that lately, have I」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, yeah... I’ve been thinking that maybe it just doesn’t suit me. Seeing Miyako made me feel that way」

name: Iori
message: 「Even Miyako can’t live all by herself. Eventually, everyone ends up living alongside someone else」

name: Iori
message: 「Of course, the same goes for you, Momiji. There isn’t a single person who can live life entirely on their own」

name: Iori
message: 「Parents, sisters, seniors, juniors, rivals... teachers. Only by connecting with many people can a person truly become who they are」

name: Iori
message: 「Sometimes, you might be able to grow stronger by casting those connections aside」

name: Iori
message: 「But even if you reject others and gain overwhelming, godlike power, you’ll just be strong—and you won’t create anything at all」

name: Iori
message: 「People can only create value through their connections with one another」

name: Iori
message: 「Independent self-reliance has no value if you can’t see what lies beyond it. That’s what I believe, at least」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah, you’re right... I think so too」
Momiji nods wistfully.

name: Momiji
message: 「Thank you, Sensei. For teaching me so much」

name: Iori
message: 「I’m glad if it helped you, Momiji」

name: Momiji
message: 「...Hey, Sensei? I have a request」

name: Iori
message: 「Hm？ What is it？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I want you to keep teaching me, Iori-sensei」

name: Momiji
message: 「After the Martial Festival ends, after summer is over, through winter, through spring, and even next year...」

name: Momiji
message: 「Will you stay my teacher... forever？」

name: Iori
message: 「...Yeah, that’s what I want, too」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Is that for real！？」

name: Iori
message: 「Whoa！？ S-Setsugekka...？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Wh-where did you come from！？ And more importantly, were you hiding there listening to us！？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That doesn’t matter right now！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Sensei... how long are you going to be my teacher？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Even after the Martial Festival is over, will you stay our teacher？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Or maybe… you’ll become my private coach？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Private coach…？」

name: Iori
message: 「……So you heard what we were talking about earlier.」
I had sensed a strange presence behind me, but it seems Setsugekka had been eavesdropping.

name: Momiji
message: 「Tell us, Teacher. What was that all about？」
……Dammit.
I hadn't wanted to bring this up with the Martial Festival so close, so I had intended to keep it hidden.
However, looking at their serious expressions, I realized there was no room for evasion.

name: Iori
message: 「……Alright, I’ll tell you everything.」
Either way, now that Setsugekka had overheard the conversation, there was no point in hiding it.
I told Momiji and Setsugekka everything I had talked about with Keisetsu, honestly.

name: Momiji
message: 「……What the hell? You’re asking for a private coach as a barter for treating Takahisa Kuki?」

name: Momiji
message: 「Isn't that just a roundabout threat？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I don’t like meddling in other families' business, but if the Kazamine are going to play hardball, we’ll have to rethink things, too.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「W-wait, Kei-chan is only doing this for my sake.」

name: Momiji
message: 「And anyway, are you even okay with the way Keisetsu is handling this, Setsugekka？」

name: Momiji
message: 「You were planning to go with Keisetsu if she went abroad, weren't you？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「T-that’s something I’ll figure out later, so never mind that.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「The problem is you, Teacher. According to Kei-chan, you’re planning to return to the Tenju Special Forces eventually, right？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Once your ‘errand’ is done, you won’t be our teacher anymore, will you？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「When is that going to be……？」

name: Iori
message: 「I don’t know yet.」

name: Iori
message: 「But if it’s early, I might have to return as soon as the Martial Festival ends.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「N-no way……」

name: Momiji
message: 「……Something’s wrong here.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Then... after the Martial Festival ends, after summer is over, when winter comes, and spring, and even next year...」

name: Momiji
message: 「You can’t stay as our teacher forever, right? But what you said earlier wasn’t a lie.」

name: Iori
message: 「Saying I want to—that’s my true feeling.」

name: Iori
message: 「...But just because I want to, doesn’t mean I can remain a teacher forever.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Why！」
Why, huh... A fair question, I suppose. I guess I really have no choice but to talk about it.

name: Iori
message: 「What I’m about to tell you is a story from my past.」

name: Iori
message: 「It’s not a topic I like to dwell on... but I’ll tell you both for your own sakes.」
I can’t leave any bitterness behind for the upcoming Martial Festival. For that reason, I’ll tell them everything.

name: Iori
message: 「It was during the Martial Festival when I was in my second year at the academy.」
I speak to the two of them as we walk slowly down the road home.

name: Iori
message: 「I had a friend who was both my rival and my best friend. Kuki Takahisa... You know who he is, right？ Asahi’s older brother.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ah!？ That’s it! That’s why I felt like I’d heard that name before!」

name: Iori
message: 「That match was the final, where I challenged Takahisa, who had become the Toujinegi as a first-year in the Martial Arts Division.」

name: Iori
message: 「We both fought with everything we had. The match favored Takahisa. But, I wanted to win no matter what.」

name: Iori
message: 「And before I knew it, I was using the Tengen Saimei-ryuu.」

name: Iori
message: 「...By the time I regained my senses, it was already too late.」

name: Iori
message: 「My Origami pierced Takahisa’s shoulder, leaving him with a grievous injury that nearly cost him the limb.」
The two of them don’t miss a single word.

name: Iori
message: 「Regenerative medicine back then was still imperfect. A full recovery would have cost an astronomical amount, and the success rate wasn’t high either.」
The Kuki family couldn’t afford it, and Takahisa was forced to give up on treatment.

name: Iori
message: 「Takahisa lost almost all the grip strength in his dominant hand. But he rehabilitated desperately and managed to return by his third year.」

name: Iori
message: 「But he didn’t perform well, and he was eliminated in the Martial Festival qualifiers. He had no choice but to give up the dream of becoming a pro that he’d cherished for so long.」

name: Iori
message: 「I stole Takahisa’s dream. The killing sword ingrained in my body committed an unforgivable sin.」

name: Iori
message: 「With that, I have no right to practice Jindou, nor do I have the right to chase after my own dreams. That’s why I gave up on my dream of becoming a teacher.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Sensei...」
Then, at my father’s recommendation, I enlisted in the Self-Defense Forces, which led me to my current posting with the Special Forces Group.

name: Iori
message: 「At first, I was resistant to this ‘errand’ as well. But I figured if it was only for a limited time, it wouldn’t hurt to indulge myself a little.」
I’ll return to my unit eventually. For the short time I have until then, I’ll just let myself have this fleeting dream… that’s all.

name: Iori
message: 「That’s why… when the time comes, I’ll return to the Tenju Special Forces. I can’t keep being a teacher forever.」

name: Momiji
message: 「…That’s strange.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Isn’t that just you being stubborn？」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha, I suppose that’s how it looks to others.」

name: Iori
message: 「But Takahisa wasn’t just any friend. We were best friends who talked about our dreams together and worked hard side-by-side.」

name: Iori
message: 「I supported his dream with all my heart. And yet, I was the one who took it away from him…」
I don’t ask for you to understand how I feel. I just don’t want the two of you to have to endure such pain.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I had no idea you were going through something like that, Sensei.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「But even so, I still want you to stay our teacher.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I don’t really understand things like qualifications or sins…」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「But！ I’m grateful for everything you’ve taught me. I want you to keep teaching me, for a long, long time.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I’ll support you… even if everyone else is against it, I’ll support you！ So… please, don’t stop being our teacher.」

name: Iori
message: 「Thank you, Setsugekka.」
I smile at Setsugekka as she pleads with me, her eyes desperate.

name: Momiji
message: 「I’m still not entirely convinced… but, well, I’m glad I got to hear your story.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I had always thought of you as some kind of superhuman, but I guess you’re just a normal person after all.」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha, that’s right. Even a teacher is just a person who deals with their own troubles.」
Ever since then, I’ve been living with feelings I can never quite resolve. But I suppose that’s just what life is.

name: Momiji
message: 「Still, I don’t think being so gloomy suits you, Sensei.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I mean, you’ve spent so much time preaching all that passionate stuff to us, yet you’re still tied down by your own past? That’s weird, you know.」

name: Momiji
message: 「If you’ve got that much passion to pour into others, I think you should try looking at yourself, too.」

name: Iori
message: 「Hahaha, indeed. You’ve got me there.」
I can clearly feel the encouragement hidden in Momiji’s words.

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, I know you have your own way of thinking and living, Sensei, so I’m not trying to force anything on you.」

name: Momiji
message: 「We... we want to be together」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah, yeah, that’s right！」

name: Iori
message: 「Momiji, Setsugekka, thank you. I’ve truly received your feelings. You’re so kind, Momiji」

name: Momiji
message: 「Eh...！？ N-no, that’s not what I meant...」
Momiji’s face turns bright red at my words.

name: Momiji
message: 「W-well, that’s all I wanted to say！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Please don’t forget our request, okay!」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, of course. Thank you both, really. I’m glad I could hear that from you」
I was happy to know how they felt.
...Truly, I wish I could have become a teacher.

name: Iori
message: 「Anyway, please keep today a secret from everyone else. I don't want to worry them over unnecessary things」

name: Iori
message: 「I want the two of you to set today aside as well, and first focus on the Martial Festival」

name: Iori
message: 「We can think about what comes after that once the Martial Festival is over」

name: Momiji
message: 「Understood. Don’t go deciding everything on your own, okay」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hmph, I’ll win the tournament and call it all even！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I won’t lose！ I’m not afraid of anything anymore！ I’m getting more and more fired up！」
Setsugekka raises both hands high. The shadows of the three of us stretched long, long down the road.
